devdoc.details: Orchestrates all user-facing actions.      - Does NOT hold ETH (all ETH goes to FundingVault).      - Delegates campaign data to CampaignManager.      - Delegates access control to AccessControl.      - Mints reward tokens via RewardToken. Function signatures must EXACTLY match STARTUPFUND_ABI in src/lib/contracts.ts.

claimRefund(uint256).details: Contributor claims a refund after campaign is CANCELLED or FLAGGED.

createCampaign(string,string,string,stri.details: Creates a new campaign. Only registered, unblocked users.

flagCampaign(uint256).details: Community member flags a suspicious campaign.

unflagCampaign(uint256).details: Removes the caller's flag from a campaign.

updateCampaign(uint256,string,string,str.details: Updates editable campaign fields. Only creator, only before first contribution.

withdraw(uint256).details: Creator withdraws funds after campaign is FUNDED.

 @dev Orchestrates all user-facing actions.
      - Does NOT hold ETH (all ETH goes to FundingVault).
      - Delegates campaign data to CampaignManager.
      - Delegates access control to AccessControl.
      - Mints reward tokens via RewardToken.
